data.body:
[P2] Renew the hold at actual invocation boundaries

`TestExecutionOrchestrator.isBusy()` includes queued functions and `timedCompletionReleased`, so it can remain true between invocations when a wait or callback queues a wakeup during the running invocation. The ending invocation calls `advance()` while that queued work still counts as busy, and starting the next invocation does not reset the hold. An expired hold therefore carries into the next invocation, letting a caller's later deadline advance immediately while a newly resumed child performs sub-second work. Reset the hold using an invocation ID or explicit lifecycle notification, and add a composed test with a wakeup queued before the previous invocation ends; manually toggling the unit-test participant to idle does not cover this transition.
